title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2 — Resource Allocation and Stage Checks
prompt: In many organisations, projects are reviewed at fixed stages before further resources are released, while in others resources are committed for the whole project at the outset. Some people believe that staged checks waste time and slow down progress, whereas others argue that they prevent serious losses. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your answer, explain which approach you think is more effective for allocating limited resources, and suggest one practical measure that could make stage checks work better. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有情境与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先通读题目，确认需要讨论的两种观点（分阶段检查与一次性投入资源），再明确你自己的立场。写作时请做到：1）分别论述双方理由，避免只写一边；2）给出个人观点并说明依据；3）提出一项具体可行的改进措施；4）使用清晰段落与衔接手段；5）字数不少于250词，建议用约5分钟规划、30分钟写作、5分钟检查。
